response.sql: WITH award_counts AS (SELECT player_id, COUNT(*) AS award_count FROM manager_award WHERE player_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY player_id), totals AS (SELECT player_id, award_count, SUM(award_count) OVER () AS total_awards FROM award_counts) SELECT player_id, award_count, 1.0 * award_count / total_awards AS fraction FROM totals WHERE total_awards IS NOT NULL ORDER BY fraction DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
